resources.string: When the user asks to install/uninstall/search/upgrade packages, change mirrors, or hits pkg/apt errors: enable and RUN this skill with real terminal tools. Do not only paste tips.

# Termux pkg install guide (executable)
> **Must execute**: When this skill matches, use tools on the real terminal (`send_terminal_command` / `read_terminal`; also `list_zerotermux_pkg_sources` / `switch_zerotermux_pkg_source` when allowed). Do not reply with text-only steps. Only stay text-only if the user explicitly says “commands only / do not run”.
## Triggers (any match → run)
- Install / uninstall / search / upgrade packages - Errors like `No mirror`, `Unable to locate package`, `Hash Sum mismatch` - How to install wget / python / git / node / curl, etc.
---
## Standard install flow (run with tools in order)
1. If mirrors fail: `list_zerotermux_pkg_sources`, then after user agrees `switch_zerotermux_pkg_source` (`user_confirmed=true`, prefer `tsinghua`); or `termux-change-repo` when interactive. 2. `send_terminal_command`: `pkg update` 3. If package name unsure: `pkg search <keyword>`, pick the exact name from output — never invent names 4. `send_terminal_command`: `pkg install -y <package>` (or multiple: `pkg install -y git curl vim`) 5. `read_terminal` to confirm; verify with `<cmd> --version` or `command -v <cmd>` 6. Tell the user **real success/failure** with relevant terminal output
### Example: install wget (fully run)
```bash pkg update pkg search wget pkg install -y wget wget --version ```
### Example: install Python
```bash pkg install -y python python --version ```
---
## Mirrors
On **`No mirror or mirror group selected`** or very slow downloads:
1. Prefer tool-based mirror switch (tsinghua default), or `termux-change-repo` 2. Then `pkg update` and retry install
---
## Upgrade / uninstall
| Need | Command to run | |------|----------------| | Update packages | `pkg update && pkg upgrade -y` | | Refresh index only | `pkg update` | | Uninstall | Confirm with `pkg list-installed`, then `pkg uninstall -y <package>` |
---
## Error handling (read full terminal first)
1. **No mirror…** → change mirror → `pkg update` → retry 2. **Unable to locate package** → `pkg search`; maybe `root-repo`/`x11-repo` → `pkg update` → retry 3. **Hash Sum mismatch** → change mirror / retry → `pkg update` 4. **unmet dependencies** → `pkg update && pkg upgrade -y` → retry; else paste full error 5. **Permission denied (storage)** → `termux-setup-storage`, ask user to grant permission 6. **command not found** → reinstall with `pkg install -y <package>` and verify
---
## Common packages
| Need | Package | Command | |------|---------|---------| | wget | wget | `pkg install -y wget` | | curl | curl | `pkg install -y curl` | | Python | python | `pkg install -y python` | | Git | git | `pkg install -y git` | | Node | nodejs | `pkg install -y nodejs` | | Clang | clang | `pkg install -y clang` | | Java | openjdk-21 | `pkg install -y openjdk-21` | | vim | vim | `pkg install -y vim` | | unzip | unzip | `pkg install -y unzip` |
---
## Discipline
1. Read full terminal output; never invent results 2. Install/upgrade/search: **execute**, don’t only tip 3. Confirm before dangerous ops (`rm -rf /`, mass uninstall, system edits) 4. Do not claim “installed” until verification output is seen 5. Do not `save_agent_skill` for this flow (already built-in)
